content: {"like":["Strong, charismatic leads in period dramas (e.g., Sean Bean in Lorna Doone).","Music that enhances period authenticity (e.g., Del Rey in Gatsby).","Well‑cast supporting roles that elevate the story (e.g., Jeremy Northam in Wuthering Heights).","Cinematic visuals that compensate for budget limits (e.g., CGI in Gatsby).","Engaging, character‑driven romance in classic noir (e.g., Turner/Turner in Postman)."],"dislike":["Over‑modern or anachronistic music in period pieces (e.g., hip‑hop in Gatsby).","Miscasting or age‑inappropriate actors in historical roles (e.g., Fiennes as Heathcliff).","Inaccurate or simplified plot adaptations that omit key characters (e.g., Lorna Doone).","Budget‑driven compromises that hurt authenticity (e.g., fake locations in Wuthering Heights).","Abrupt or altered endings that deviate from source material (e.g., Flowers in the Attic)."]}
